direction_as_read: positive on a named primary outcome in one trial of a ruscus extract in women with chronic venous insufficiency, at a dose the abstract does not print
decision: held: dose of the Fagorutin Ruscus extract in PMID 12040966 is not in the abstract and no open full text was shown, so rule 2's verified dose can't be met or ruled out
summary: Four labels print butcher's broom root at 720 or 940 mg per serving; label text seen on 251524 says traditional leg vein support, and 327889 prints 720 mg root per 2 capsules. The only trial of ruscus alone found is 12040966: 148 women with chronic venous insufficiency, placebo controlled, positive on the named primary outcome of leg volume change over 12 weeks. Its abstract states no mg dose and no extract ratio. Every other trial and meta-analysis found tested the combination with hesperidin methyl chalcone or hesperidin and vitamin C (28225220, 14612852, 3048951).

population.description: 166 women with chronic venous insufficiency (Widmer I-II, CEAP 3-4) included; 148 in the intent-to-treat analysis, aged 30-89.

outcomes.name: Primary: area under baseline of leg volume change over 12 weeks (AUB0-12), significant difference from placebo, -827 ml x day
Leg volume change at weeks 8 and 12 (-16.5 ml and -20.5 ml), ankle and leg circumference
Heavy tired legs and sensation of tension at week 12

limitations: Abstract gives no amount in mg, only 'the recommended daily dosage according to the German monograph'; no dose invented here.
Study product is a ruscus extract (Fagorutin Ruscus Kapseln); the abstract prints no extract ratio or saponin content. Labels print butcher's broom root in mg, with no extract stated in the rows.
Abstract as read on PubMed; full text not read.
Drafted from the source by agent review (Claude) on 2026-11-04; not clinician reviewed.

dose.reported_regimen: Ruscus extract (Fagorutin Ruscus Kapseln), recommended daily dosage according to the German monograph, 12 weeks; amount not printed in the abstract.

normalization.basis: Assigned daily amount as printed in the source; no conversion.

read_not_used.35893088: Symposium review of the combination of Ruscus extract, hesperidin methyl chalcone and vitamin C; not ruscus alone.
read_not_used.28225220: Meta-analysis of venoactive drugs containing Ruscus (Cyclo 3 fort constituents); abstract does not separate ruscus alone.
read_not_used.14612852: Meta-analysis of Cyclo 3 Fort, a combination with hesperidin methyl chalcone and ascorbic acid.
read_not_used.3048951: Double-blind crossover of a combination, Ruscus extract 16.5 mg with hesperidin and ascorbic acid.

stop_or_hold: Dose of 12040966 is needed from the full text (2002, no PMC id seen). Even with it, fields can't compare an extract at a monograph dose with labels printing root mg and no ratio. Row canonical on all 4 labels is butcher_s_broom, while the record and the74 use butchers_broom_root; labels.py printed empty rows for that reason.
